<noscript>
  <h1>Subset construction</h1>
  <p>After every prefix, the DFA state is exactly the set of NFA states reachable after that prefix. The union transition preserves this equality one symbol at a time, and a subset is final exactly when it contains an NFA final state.</p>
</noscript>
